description: Builds an llms.txt file — an optional convention for describing a site and its key pages, with no demonstrated effect on Google — from a name, a one-sentence description and a list of key pages. Pure text generation — fetches nothing.

description.description: A one-sentence summary of what the site is.

key_pages.description: Pages worth pointing an AI system to, most important first.

description.description: One line describing what the page covers.

name.description: The site or product name for the llms.txt header.

title: Generate an llms.txt file
